6.speaker: Player_Romus
6.text: "As you know, we're at war. I would humbly ask for the assistance of your great warrior culture."

8.speaker: Jorga Azmal
8.text: "But if you insist, I can sell you our latest missile system. It's good enough to compete with Lespia's, but it does not come cheap."

9.speaker: Jorga Azmal
9.text: "To be honest, it makes no difference to me who is in charge of the Pales peninsula."

10.speaker: Player_Romus
10.text: "I was thinking of something with a little more finesse."

11.speaker: Player_Romus
11.text: "Sounds perfect. But I don't think my kingdom can afford such a mighty weapon."

12.speaker: Player_Romus
12.text: "To safeguard God's creations, we must invoke the power of the heavens."

16.speaker: Jorga Azmal
16.text: "If you're referring to our mercenaries, I'm afraid I can't help you."

17.speaker: Player_Romus
17.text: "Great. The Palesians won't know what hit them."

19.speaker: Jorga Azmal
19.text: "My Disciples will not risk their lives for a kingdom where their right to practice their religion is not recognized."

20.speaker: Jorga Azmal
20.text: "Once you buy them, they are yours to wield at your discretion."

21.speaker: Sal Ignacius
21.text: "Remember, these weapons are to be wielded with mercy, not wrath. Correct, Supreme Wiseman?"

22.speaker: Jorga Azmal
22.text: "You don't need to impress me with religious talk, Your Majesty. This is just business."

24.speaker: Player_Romus
24.text: "Yes. I thank you for your willingness to aid our military, despite our religious differences." [-3 Budget]

25.speaker: Player_Romus
25.text: "Yes. Your weapons were all I came here for, anyway." [-3 Budget]

26.speaker: Jorga Azmal
26.text: "Rizia has laid the foundations for the acceptance of Golcondism. I have not lost hope."

27.speaker: Jorga Azmal
27.text: "May they serve you well against the godless Palesians."

28.speaker: Player_Romus
28.text: "No, Rizia does not need or want your missiles."

29.speaker: Player_Romus
29.text: "No, I'd rather you did something else for me."

30.speaker: Jorga Azmal
30.text: "Our mercenaries have been helping win wars since the days of the Empire of Moridia."

31.speaker: Jorga Azmal
31.text: "May God bless and save your troops, then."

32.speaker: Jorga Azmal
32.text: "You saw my Disciples earlier. Imagine a larger team, just as trained, wielding sophisticated weaponry and stealth technology."

36.speaker: Player_Romus
36.text: "They won't fight for Rizia. But maybe they will fight *against* Wehlen."

38.speaker: Player_Romus
38.text: "Together, we will emancipate Zille and humiliate Wehlen."

39.speaker: Jorga Azmal
39.text: "But they will not fight for a kingdom that does not recognize their right to practice their religion."

41.speaker: Jorga Azmal
41.text: "And perhaps, lay the foundation for Golcondist acceptance in Rizia."

42.speaker: Player_Romus
42.text: "We are at risk of losing the territory of Zille to Wehlen. I would humbly call upon your great warrior culture for assistance."

47.speaker: Jorga Azmal
47.text: "The missiles are just business. Once you buy them, they're yours to use at your discretion."

52.speaker: Jorga Azmal
52.text: "You would rather continue to appease Smolak? 'It is easier to calm a storm with whispers than satisfy the whims of a madman.'"

53.speaker: Jorga Azmal
53.text: "They are scared of nothing. Have you come here to negotiate with me, or to belittle my people and our way of life?"

54.speaker: Jorga Azmal
54.text: "That depends, Your Majesty. What else do you want?"

55.speaker: Jorga Azmal
55.text: "Then it is up to God to forgive you."

56.speaker: Player_Romus
56.text: "Or maybe they're just scared of losing."

58.speaker: Player_Romus
58.text: "Fine. Rizia will withdraw from Wehlen's anti-BFF operations in exchange for the aid of Derdian mercenaries in the Zille resistance movement." [-1 Budget]

61.speaker: Player_Romus
61.text: "We will regretfully be continuing our participation in Wehlen's anti-BFF operations. I withdraw my request for mercenary aid."

65.speaker: Jorga Azmal
65.text: "I would consider lending you my Disciples' services. For a fee."

66.speaker: Player_Romus
66.text: "Sounds like a plan. Your men are hired." [-1 Budget]

67.speaker: Jorga Azmal
67.text: "It is true that Smolak's anti-Golcondist regime has been a constant source of grief for myself and my countrymen."

69.speaker: Player_Romus
69.text: "It doesn't sound like I can count on their loyalty."

70.speaker: Player_Romus
70.text: "Actually, please disregard my request. This is not the way that we get Zille back."

71.speaker: Jorga Azmal
71.text: "You can count on them to do serious damage to the Wehzek enemy."

72.speaker: Sal Ignacius
72.text: "Rizia would never engage in persecution, Supreme Wiseman. Our cooperation with Wehlen is an anti-terrorist measure."

73.speaker: Jorga Azmal
73.text: "It is not 'terror' to defend one's right to exist."

74.speaker: Player_Romus
74.text: "We had no choice. Making that deal with Wehlen was the only way to get Zille back."

75.speaker: Player_Romus
75.text: "I sympathize with what the Bludish have gone through. That does not mean violence is the answer."

76.speaker: Player_Romus
76.text: "I fully agree with you. I don't want to participate in Wehlen's anti-Blud operations any longer."

77.speaker: Jorga Azmal
77.text: "If you are so confident Zille will be returned through cooperation with Wehlen, why are you even inquiring about my mercenaries?"

78.speaker: Jorga Azmal
78.text: "Then what is the answer? Meekly allowing the eradication of their entire people?"

80.speaker: Jorga Azmal
80.text: "Not as long as Rizia continues to aid Wehlen in its campaign of anti-Golcondist persecution."

81.speaker: Jorga Azmal
81.text: "But as long as Rizia is aiding Wehlen in its campaign of persecution, we will not involve ourselves."

82.speaker: Player_Romus
82.text: "Unfortunately, our treasury is low on funds. Can I compensate you some other way?"

86.speaker: Jorga Azmal
86.text: "We will do business with Rizia. But no more than that."

91.speaker: Jorga Azmal
91.text: "This is my compromise. End your cooperation with Wiktor Smolak, and I will sell you a small mercenary detail."

94.speaker: Player_Romus
94.text: "What does a spiritual leader like yourself want with money?"

95.speaker: Jorga Azmal
95.text: "I have a country to run and few trade partners, Your Majesty. Engaging with the material world is a necessity."

97.speaker: Jorga Azmal
97.text: "If the price was right, I could lend you a small detail."

99.speaker: Jorga Azmal
99.text: "If only for the purpose of striking back at Wiktor Smolak and his anti-Golcondist regime."

100.speaker: Player_Romus
100.text: "I spoke too soon. My kingdom cannot afford to hire your men."

106.speaker: Player_Romus
106.text: "Supreme Wiseman, your missile technology is superior to anything we could achieve in Rizia. I want to purchase one of your systems."

112.speaker: Jorga Azmal
112.text: "Indeed, our defense agency's research and development department is the pride and joy of the Silver Garrison."

113.speaker: Jorga Azmal
113.text: "But I am curious why Rizia is in need of such technology. You are not at war, after all."

114.speaker: Player_Romus
114.text: "Yes, and I want it to stay that way. The more intimidating our weapons, the less our enemies will want to provoke us."

118.speaker: Jorga Azmal
118.text: "I understand. We ourselves developed this technology in pursuit of peace, not aggression."

122.speaker: Player_Romus
122.text: "A holy reckoning may soon be at our doorstep. We must be prepared to wield the instruments of justice."

123.speaker: Jorga Azmal
123.text: "I am sorry, Your Majesty, but I will have to deny this request. Our missiles were developed in pursuit of peace, not economic gain."

125.speaker: Jorga Azmal
125.text: "With the way things are going in the world, such a reckoning may indeed be close at hand."

127.speaker: Player_Romus
127.text: "We in Rizia are developing a robust weapons export trade. I can sell these missiles to countries that otherwise would never deal with Derdia."

128.speaker: Player_Romus
128.text: "I fear Merkopa may be on the cusp of a major geopolitical conflict. I don't want to leave Rizia defenseless."

130.speaker: Player_Romus
130.text: "This is an economic move. Rizia can sell these missiles to countries that otherwise would never deal with Derdia."

131.speaker: Jorga Azmal
131.text: "What, so that they may rain back down on our heads?"

133.speaker: Jorga Azmal
133.text: "I sense it in the air as well. Each of us should be prepared to hold our own against the godless so-called 'superpowers'."

135.speaker: Player_Romus
135.text: "I understand that. For such a priceless treasure, I will pay whatever you ask." [-3 Budget]

140.speaker: Jorga Azmal
140.text: "I am prepared to make a deal. But know that this weaponry is the product of years of hard work. It cannot be undervalued."

141.speaker: Sal Ignacius
141.text: "Remember, these weapons are to be wielded with mercy, not wrath. Correct, Supreme Wiseman?"

142.speaker: Jorga Azmal
142.text: "Wrath can be a powerful tool in the hands of the righteous, Grand Wiseman."

143.speaker: Jorga Azmal
143.text: "You are disrespecting our craftsmanship. Perhaps it's for the best that you don't buy it."

145.speaker: Player_Romus
145.text: "Wouldn't you be willing to lower the price as part of a good-faith agreement between neighbors?"

146.speaker: Player_Romus
146.text: "I appreciate that. But such a price does not fit in with my economic plans for Rizia."

147.speaker: Jorga Azmal
147.text: "Perhaps that's just as well. It would be a great risk to place such a powerful weapon in the hands of a man I don't fully trust."

148.speaker: Player_Romus
148.text: "Don't delude yourself, Azmal. Nobody else is willing to trade with you. Any offer I give you is the best you're going to get."
